tagline: Hidden drought: where rain looks normal but groundwater is running low
legend_provisional: Lighter shade = provisional (groundwater record of only 2-4 years)
legend_none: No data (hover a district for the reason)
why_gw_level_only: groundwater wells too new to compare with past years
why_season_just_started: rain season started less than 15 days ago
panel_hint: Select a district on the map, or search for one.
reason_deviation: rainfall was 20% or more below normal
reason_dry_spell: a dry spell of {n} weeks (each under half the normal rain)
gw_percentile_explain: {p} means water is deeper now than in {d}% of past years at this time of year. 20 or less counts as low.
gw_vs_ly: Change vs same time last year
gw_chart_title: Water level vs usual (m, up = higher water)
stress_hidden: This district looks fine overall, but at least one block inside it is Critical or Over-exploited.
idm_chart_title: Share of district in drought (D1+), last 26 weeks
asof_line: Rain: {rain} · Groundwater: {gw} · Drought index: week of {idm} · Stress: IN-GRES 2025-26
snapshot_note: Snapshot of {date}. Rain: IMD (gridded for past years) · Groundwater: CGWB wells · Stress: {edition}
footer: Data: India Meteorological Department (rainfall), Central Ground Water Board via National Water Data Portal (well levels), IN-GRES by CGWB & IIT Hyderabad (stress), India Drought Monitor by IIT Gandhinagar (drought index). Not an official drought declaration.
idm_unavailable: The drought index starts in July 2021, so there is no data for this date.
stress_unavailable: IN-GRES stress assessments start with 2019-20, so there is no stress data for this date.
layer_empty: No data for this layer on this date.
col_category_help: Combines rain and groundwater: Fine, Buffered (rain short, groundwater OK), Hidden drought (rain OK, groundwater low), Double drought (both short). 'Provisional' = groundwater history of only 2-4 years.
col_rain_help: This season's rain in IMD's classes (Large excess to No rain). A note such as 'dry spell 4 wk' or 'SPI -1.2' shows another reason the rain counted as short.
col_rain_dep_help: Season rainfall so far, as % above (+) or below (−) the 1971-2020 normal. −20% or lower is 'Deficient'.
col_gw_pct_help: 0-100. Compares each well with its own readings at the same time of year in past years. 0 = water is deeper than ever recorded; 20 or less = low.
col_gw_tier_help: How much well history backs the percentile: Full (5+ wells, 10+ years), Short record (3+ wells, 5+ years), Provisional (2-4 years).
col_stress_help: Official IN-GRES assessment of yearly pumping vs recharge. Over-exploited = pumping more than is recharged (stage above 100%).
col_idm_help: IIT Gandhinagar's weekly combined drought index (rain, soil moisture, runoff): Normal, D0 abnormally dry, up to D4 exceptional.
tagline_gap: Drought is declared mainly on rainfall, so a district with normal rain and falling groundwater gets no declaration. This site shows both, for every district.
layer_quadrant_help: Combines rain and groundwater into four groups: Fine, Buffered (rain short, groundwater OK), Hidden drought (rain OK, groundwater low) and Double drought (both short).
layer_rain_help: Rain since the season began, compared with the normal for the same dates (IMD's classes, Large excess to No rain).
layer_gw_help: How deep the water in wells is now, compared with the same time of year in all earlier years on record (not just the previous reading). Low = among the lowest 20% of those years.
layer_stress_help: The official yearly assessment of how much groundwater is pumped compared with how much is recharged. Dates start in January 2020.
layer_idm_help: IIT Gandhinagar's weekly drought index, which combines rain, soil moisture and runoff. Dates start in August 2021.
ctl_date_help: Latest = the newest data. Earlier dates are snapshots at the end of January, May (pre-monsoon), August and November (post-monsoon), back to 2000. The number beside each date is how many districts could be given a drought category then.
date_moved: {layer} has no data before {date}, so the date was moved to {date}.
notice_no_others: No other data for this district on this date.
zoom_in: Zoom in (or pinch, or Ctrl/Cmd + scroll)
col_rain_spi_help: Standardized Precipitation Index for the season: how unusual the rain total is for this district. 0 = typical; −1.0 or lower counts as short.
col_rain_dry_help: Longest run of weeks in the season with under half the normal rain. 4 or more counts as short.
col_rain_src_help: IMD official = IMD's published district figure. IMD gridded = our district average of IMD's rainfall grid, used for past years and where IMD lists no figure.
col_gw_depth_help: Median depth from the ground surface down to the water across the district's wells. A larger number means deeper water.
col_gw_ly_help: Median change in the wells' water level since the same time last year. + = water rose, − = water fell.
col_gw_10y_help: Water level compared with each well's own average for this time of year over the previous 10 years. + = higher than usual, − = lower.
col_gw_wells_help: Number of wells with a reading for this date.
col_stress_stage_help: Yearly groundwater extraction as a % of the recharge that can be extracted. Above 100% = Over-exploited.
col_stress_ed_help: The IN-GRES assessment year these stress figures come from.
col_idm_cdi_help: District average of IIT Gandhinagar's Combined Drought Index. Lower = drier; −0.5 or lower is D0, −0.8 or lower is D1.
col_idm_area_help: Share of the district's area classed D0 (abnormally dry) or worse.
